history.period: Unverified antiquity; lightuptemples claims over 1,000 years old (unsubstantiated - flag)
history.summary: A privately-owned Shiva temple on the Dehradun-Mussoorie Road at Kuthal Gate (Mussoorie Rd, Salan Gaon), about 12 km from Dehradun city, noted for its dark-red exterior and a crystal shivlinga (said by the temple committee to be millions of years old and formed of ice crystals). Its signature feature is a strict 'no donation' policy: there is no donation box inside or outside, prasad and money are refused, and free tea and bhandara are served to devotees. The temple sees heavy footfall on Shivratri and during Sawan. FLAG: the >1,000-year age claim and 'millions of years old shivlinga' claim are not substantiated by any historical source (verify).

name: Shri Prakasheshwar Mahadev Mandir
town_description: Dehradun is the capital city of Uttarakhand, set in the Doon Valley at the foothills of the Himalayas. Known as the 'School Capital of India' with institutions like The Doon School and the Forest Research Institute, it is also the gateway to the hill station of Mussoorie and a base for Char Dham pilgrims.

travel.road: On Mussoorie Road at Kuthal Gate, 12 km from Dehradun city; well connected by bus, taxi and car

visitor_information.best_time: Shivratri and the month of Sawan; mornings and evenings on regular days
